name: vw-mcp
description: Lets Claude script Vectorworks through the vw-mcp plug-in. Every call is safety-checked.
long_description: Requires the vw-mcp plug-in installed and enabled in Vectorworks 2027 (macOS). The plug-in starts with Vectorworks; this extension finds it automatically. Calls that crash, hang or open dialogs are refused before they run, and each job is one undo step. Beta: test on copies of your drawings.

tools.name: vw_bridge_status
tools.description: Check the connection to Vectorworks and the safety table in use.

tools.name: execute_script
tools.description: Run safety-checked Python inside the open Vectorworks document.

tools.name: run_native_op
tools.description: Change the document through native SDK calls instead of Python.

tools.name: vw_lookup_function
tools.description: Look up a vs.* function's safety class, checks and signature.
